title: ReDoS ambiguity and catastrophic-backtracking detection
attackSurface: Untrusted regular expressions accepted by validators, routing configuration or plugins

hostile.title: Nested quantifier overlap
hostile.why: Nested unbounded repetition over the same character creates exponential partitions

hostile.title: Overlapping alternation branches
hostile.why: Both alternation branches can consume overlapping prefixes

hostile.title: Word and optional-space loop
hostile.why: The canonical teaching ReDoS shape allows many ways to consume whitespace-separated input

hostile.title: Nested digit repetition
hostile.why: A digit run can be partitioned across nested repetitions in many ways

hostile.title: Adjacent digit quantifiers
hostile.why: Adjacent unbounded digit scans overlap and backtrack quadratically

hostile.title: Wildcard chain
hostile.why: Three unbounded wildcard scans create high-order backtracking

hostile.title: Quantified backreference loop
hostile.why: A quantified loop containing a backreference multiplies matching possibilities

hostile.title: Nullable quantified body
hostile.why: A loop body that can match empty input creates degenerate backtracking behavior

benign.title: Bounded lowercase slug
benign.why: A bounded character class with no nested ambiguity

benign.title: Date shape
benign.why: Fixed-width digit groups separated by literals

benign.title: Hex color
benign.why: Exactly six hexadecimal digits after a literal prefix

benign.title: Bounded asset path
benign.why: A bounded path character class after a literal prefix

benign.title: Fixed-stride base64 groups
benign.why: Fixed-length units have exactly one partition per input run

benign.title: Bounded non-whitespace token
benign.why: A bounded negated class without adjacent ambiguous repetition

benign.title: Positive decimal identifier
benign.why: A bounded decimal identifier with a fixed leading nonzero digit

benign.title: Bounded label alphabet
benign.why: A bounded single character class with no quantifier nesting
